name: Dwight Maverick

tenures.role: wrestler — his profile lists one High Velocity, one Ladder and one Heavy-Pro title and three World Title reigns in his first six months in EPW

entrance_music.verbatim: Wanted: Dead or Alive by Bon Jovi

tenures.note: First seen on EPW's card for its Full of Gold pay-per-view, posted 21 April 2002, where he is billed "The Texas Nightmare" Dwight Maverick; his profile of 30 January 2003 says he left EPW on 11 September 2002 to join the Army and has returned, and EPW's card for Exciter of the Ring II (25 January 2003) bills him in an American Title match.

caption: EPW's "One True Vigilante", a Texas rodeo cowboy turned brawler who held its World Title three times in his first six months, left to join the Army in September 2002 and came back in January 2003.

name: Time Bomb

tenures.role: wrestler — his profile has him train and win titles in NGW, go undefeated in AW and join EPW
tenures.note: First seen on EPW's preview of Exciter of the Ring II, posted 25 January 2003, which has him challenging the Outlaw Champion undefeated since he was signed; his profile of 2 February 2003 is the other source. The profile says he trained and won titles in NGW and was undefeated in AW; no document held ties it to the NGW record of the same name.

caption: An EPW heel of early 2003, a high flyer from Portsmouth who came up through NGW and AW, was booked against the Outlaw Champion at Exciter of the Ring II and finishes with the X-Plosion frogsplash.

identity.note: Shares the name Time Bomb with records in four other wings. The profile has him train and win titles in NGW, and the NGW record of the same name is the likeliest match, but that record's tenure runs to November 2004, long after this profile, and no document held names the two together; the rows stay apart under the no-merge default.
